LEADERBOARD

The key you opened this room with deletes rows too. It is kept on this phone only and never goes into your save.

Multipliers apply live. Crew at start needs a new run; the troop buttons land in the run you are already in, so they do nothing on the title screen. The Gatling Knight is normally a pink jackpot only, about one spin in 2,000, which is no way to test him.
Cannons stop at 12 and bombardiers at 24, because that is where the game stops counting them — a button that pushed past it would change the number and nothing else.
"Jump to the keep" moves the castle to 170m ahead of you.

You are the King — you start alone. Drag to steer left and right (or ← → / A D); the run carries you forward. The King fires on his own, always straight ahead, so your job is lane choice and dodging. Damage is pure collision: slip past a body and it costs you nothing. Shoot a gate to raise its number before you cross it. Watch for the orange bomb carriers and the glowing hoarders. Green chips lie where they fall — nothing is pulled in, so steer the crew over them to collect. And when The Grinder comes, kill it before it reaches you — once it takes hold you crawl, and it eats the crew alive.
